title: Scholarship Priority Calculator
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Rank scholarships by expected dollars per hour of work, see how renewability and reusing an essay change the ranking, and fit the best ones into the hours you have.

learningObjectives: Students will prioritize a list of scholarships by calculating expected value per hour of work and judge how renewability and reusable essays change the ranking.

controls: Scholarship name, amount, awards, applicants, hours, and years inputs
Renewable and Can reuse an existing essay checkboxes
Add, Remove selected, two presets, and Clear buttons

keyQuestions: Why can a likely $1,000 be worth more than an unlikely $10,000?
How does reusing an essay change which scholarships are worth applying for?
Where can you find out how many students applied last year?
commonMisconceptions: Bigger national scholarships are always the best use of time.
Local scholarships are too small to matter.
assessmentOpportunities: Students rank five scholarships by value per hour and justify which to apply for within a fixed time budget.
